~ Untitled Discourses on the Eye, Etc.

Ekādasahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako bhabbo gogaṇaṁ pariharituṁ phātikātuṁ. “Mendicants, a cowherd with eleven factors can maintain and expand a herd of cattle. Katamehi ekādasahi? What eleven? Idha, bhikkhave, gopālako rūpaññū hoti… pe… It’s when a cowherd knows form …

Evameva kho, bhikkhave, ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo cakkhusmiṁ aniccānupassī viharituṁ… In the same way, a mendicant with eleven qualities can meditate observing impermanence in the eye … pe… paṭinissaggānupassī viharitunti. meditate observing letting go. …”
